where.if: AND ( document ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR author_source ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR array_to_string(keywords, ',') ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR context_trigger ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR id ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cms.wisdoms ( id, domain, document, category, author_source, keywords, context_trigger ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{domain}, #{document}, #{category}, #{authorSource}, #{keywords, typeHandler=kr.co.kalpa.pcms.common.typehandler.StringListTypeHandler}, #{contextTrigger} )
mapper.update: UPDATE cms.wisdoms SET domain = #{domain}, document = #{document}, category = #{category}, author_source = #{authorSource}, keywords = #{keywords, typeHandler=kr.co.kalpa.pcms.common.typehandler.StringListTypeHandler}, context_trigger = #{contextTrigger} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT id, domain, document, category, author_source, keywords, context_trigger, last_modified_at FROM cms.wisdoms
ORDER BY last_modified_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{skip}
SELECT DISTINCT domain FROM cms.wisdoms WHERE domain IS NOT NULL AND domain != '' ORDER BY domain
SELECT id FROM cms.wisdoms WHERE id LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%') ORDER BY length(id) DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
